critical_code_review_comments: src/components/AppImage.tsx is a clean ~40-line drop-in wrapper. The resizeMode→contentFit mapping (line 34: `contentFit ?? resizeMode ?? 'cover'`) preserves RN <Image> API contract, so every caller that still passes resizeMode='cover'|'contain' (e.g. wishlist.tsx:605, claim/[id].tsx:221, insurance-claims/[id].tsx:275/386, for-sale.tsx:154) keeps working without per-call refactor. cachePolicy default 'memory-disk' and transition=0 are sensible defaults that match RN <Image>'s instant-render behavior.

Grep confirms 51 AppImage usages spread across all the user-photo screens listed in the request (inventory list, tool detail gallery, for-sale, maintenance, wishlist, claims tab broken+tool photos, warranty-claims, claim detail (lightbox uses resizeMode='contain'), bundle list+detail+edit, insurance-claims thumbnails+full evidence, borrower detail, dealer tools, dealer-claims thumbs, claims-history, DocumentsSection receipts/docs, tool/edit photo grid+receipts). No user-photo render path was missed.

Lingering `Image` imports from 'react-native' in warranty.tsx:3 and borrower/[id].tsx:3 are dead-code (no <Image .../> JSX remains in those files — only <AppImage>). Other RN-Image imports (DealerLogo.tsx, IndustrialBanner.tsx, IndustrialPanel.tsx) are CORRECT and intentionally NOT migrated — they render static metal-skin PNGs / dealer-logo assets, exactly what the AppImage docstring (line 23) says to keep on RN's <Image>.

0 broken tags across 13 distinct photo-heavy screens including stress-tested rapid navigation. expo-image's recyclingKey/disk-cache behavior cannot be observed in web preview, but the render contract is intact — base64 data-URIs and remote dealer logos all decoded successfully.

Console output is clean of any expo-image specific errors/warnings. Only pre-existing Expo SDK 54 deprecation noise ('textShadow*', 'props.pointerEvents') and pre-auth 401s during initial load remain — all carried over from prior iterations.
